{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries
print(f"Number of unique patient_id entries: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total number of rows: {len(df)}")

# Check if any patient_id appears more than once
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated().any()
print(f"Are there any duplicate patient_id entries? {duplicate_patients}")"}
